g.text: C8/C9: ASIC5 DATA6/7 · D8/D9: ASIC6 DATA4/5
Nearby true GND balls keep their own accesses.
Outlined end markers identify annotations, not pads.
No selected signal reaches its DF40 contact yet.
C31.2 → GND → true U1.D12 and reference planes.
Front balls and vias shown on their actual layer.
The C31 return uses D12; grounded tie-offs are not anchors.
Both positive accesses meet actual native fill.
The wider regulator distribution remains unrouted.
Dashed blue = L3 signal projections, not L4 copper.
GND captures join the filled reference; antipads remain visible.
FPGA V58 · BGA escape and local bypass study
Actual integrated PCB geometry · all views are unmirrored plan orientation (X right, Y down)
Partial local access only. Four signal handoffs remain open; HDI construction, impedance and PDN behavior are unqualified.
